get_dataset_info: get dataset information from the HuggingFace Hub for a given dataset ID and endpoint
get_entity_info: get entity information for a HuggingFace user or organization using the whoisthis API
get_latest_revision_or_raise: get the latest supported dataset revision or raise an error if the dataset is not supported
delete_dataset: delete a dataset and its associated cache entries using storage clients
backfill_dataset: backfill a dataset by checking support, deleting if needed, and running backfill tasks
